notes.title: Solution For Video Crashes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We've noticed that a few players are experiencing issues with animations causing the game to freeze or crash. To address this, we've introduced an alternative animation system using image strips, which should help prevent these issues. You can also choose to disable animations entirely if needed.

[b]Note:[/b] If you're not experiencing any issues with the animations, there's no need to change your current animation settings.

[h2]To switch to the new animation system:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Go to the main menu and click on Settings.
[*] Select Video Options.
[*] Under Animation, choose "Strips."
[/olist]
Please let us know if this solution works for you.

With Love, 
The Love-Joint Team.

notes.title: Small patch for the Gallery
notes.content:
Hi there,

We just released a small patch to fix a bug with Gallery persistence data across different save profiles (previously, Gallery data was always being stored in the Default profile).

We’re still hard at work investigating the crashes and the achievements not unlocking on macOS. We’ll have more updates soon!

Cheers!

notes.title: Shale Hill Secrets development update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, how's it going?

We wanted to say hello and let you know we haven't forgotten about Steam! We're still working and adjusting some things to launch the game here. Unfortunately, we’re having some headaches that every game developer faces along the way…

To be more specific, some parts of the game's original code need updating and reworking for this platform, but it's nothing too serious and we're already finishing up with all of that. We're also taking the opportunity to touch up the animations, remastering all of them, increasing the videos resolution, improving the loops, and, especially, tweaking the sound effects.

Anyway, we're a very small team and some tasks end up taking more time than we expected, but the game is 95% ready for Steam and very soon we'll have a launch date.
Stay tuned and thanks for your interest!
